selection_rule: Quality-aware next observation requested by parent after actual January11/16 cloud-only results. Among the same complete frozen unfiltered catalogue contacts at each exact original centre, require acquisition calendar date strictly later than that key latest actual observation; exclude same-observation duplicates/reprocessing. Rank declared scene cloud first, then acquisition time and literal item ID. No desired surface class, actual source values or per-key masks are inspected for selection. Other keys dates/items do not veto a candidate. Metadata quality remains context rather than proof of valid clear centre data; reuse compatible prior whole blocks.
